roleTitle: Vendor Management Analyst, Cloud Software Procurement
jobDescription: The software company's procurement team manages the vendors behind its cloud infrastructure and the software tools its teams use. The Vendor Management Analyst prepares the vendor reviews and renewal analyses, maintains the vendor risk register, runs the renewal calendar, prepares the negotiation briefs for the procurement manager, and documents each renewal's open items. Contract signature and negotiation decisions stay with the procurement manager. Reports to the procurement manager; works with the finance business partner, the security team and the vendors' account managers.
requirements: Prepares vendor reviews and renewal analyses under the procurement team's review template.
Maintains the vendor risk register with the security team's assessments.
Runs the renewal calendar and prepares the negotiation briefs, with negotiation decisions staying with the procurement manager.
Coordinates renewal inputs with the finance business partner and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each renewal's open items and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Vendor management analyst in the procurement team of a software company for three years, preparing the vendor reviews and renewal analyses for about forty cloud and software vendors a year under the team's review template.
Maintained the vendor risk register with the security team's assessments, updating it after each security review and each contract change.
Ran the renewal calendar and prepared the negotiation briefs for the procurement manager; the negotiation decisions and the contract signatures were the manager's, recorded on the renewal record.
Coordinated renewal inputs with the finance business partner through the renewal record, recording which figures were mine and which were finance's.
Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each renewal in the renewal record's closure section.

Work sample: one vendor review, one renewal analysis with its negotiation brief and the manager's decision record, and the vendor risk register extract for one quarter, with the procurement system references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former procurement manager: confirmed the candidate prepared the reviews and briefs in the period while negotiation decisions stayed with the manager, and confirmed the employment dates.
Panel note: please keep the packet to the evidence per requirement and list the follow-up questions separately; the panel will form its own view at the debrief.

propositions.text: The candidate prepared vendor reviews and renewal analyses for about forty cloud and software vendors a year under a software company's procurement review template for three years, and maintained the vendor risk register with the security team's assessments.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the review and the register extract document the reviews and the register.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the renewal calendar and prepared the negotiation briefs, with the negotiation decisions and contract signatures staying with the procurement manager.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the decision record and the reference call document the briefs and the decision boundary.

propositions.text: The candidate coordinated renewal inputs with the finance business partner through the renewal record with the origin of each figure recorded, and wrote the open items note and hand-over conditions for each renewal.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the coordination and the closure notes.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the reviews, the register, the briefs and decision boundary, the coordination and the closure notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the decision boundary as documented: briefs by the candidate, negotiation decisions and signatures by the procurement manager; the packet makes no judgement.
followUpTargets: Ask for the procurement system references so the decision records can be checked.
